// A surface recorded as a lattice of positions: Points holds one 3D position
// per (column, row) sample of the UV domain, with columns spanning U and
// rows spanning V uniformly across UvDomain.
type SampledSurfaceGrid
    implements IValue, IDeformable3D
{
    UvDomain: Bounds2D;
    Points: Array2D<Point3D>;
}
